text:
Maria (CS): Reva from QuantumFlux emailed — asking for APAC region enable + temporary demo burst for next Tue. Needs IP allowlist + 300 qps for a 4h window, and a region pin to avoid traffic being routed elsewhere. They mentioned an executive demo, want to avoid throttling. Can infra/security provision and confirm? cc @Anika @Liam @Kevin
Reva (QuantumFlux): Confirming: requested window 2026-03-31 09:00-13:00 SGT, qps=300, IPs: 203.0.113.45/32, 198.51.100.12/32. Also need CORS allowed for *.quantumflux.ai and a scoped demo API key. Thanks!
Anika (Eng Infra): We can spin up an APAC edge route in sg1 and add route pinning for tenant=quantumflux. Need reserved burst capacity — @Liam can you carve out 2 x g4dn for the 4h window? Also need the allowlist entries to push to prod ACLs.
Liam (SRE): Quick capacity check: 2x g4dn should be fine for 300 qps for standard text-gen, but streaming + many simultaneous connections could increase load. Recommend 3x as buffer. I'll reserve 2 now and set autoscale policy so we can hit 3 if we see >60% utilization. Tagging infra-team.
Kevin (Security): IP allowlist is straightforward. We'll require a signed AUP + an explicit token usage window to scope the demo key. Also recommend disabling verbose request logging for that tenant during the demo (PII concerns). @Maria can you confirm AUP timeline?
Maria (CS): I'll send the AUP and a short enablement checklist now. Reva — can you sign and return by EOD today so we can issue scoped demo tokens? We'll include instructions for using the scoped key and the CORS config.
Reva (QuantumFlux): We can sign today. One more ask: can you disable telemetry/log retention for that token (we don't want demo requests retained)? Also, can you set the demo key to only allow the generation model v1.2?
Kevin (Security): Yes — we can disable user-level logging and set retention=0 for the demo tokens. We'll also scope the token to model=v1.2 and to the specified IP CIDRs. Creating a security ticket now.
Liam (SRE): Provisioned initial capacity: 2x g4dn in ap-southeast-1 for tenant=quantumflux and added an autoscale policy: min=2 max=4, scale-trigger=cpu>65% for 3m. Staging ACL updated with provided IPs. Will push prod ACL once CS confirms signed AUP.
Anika (Eng Infra): Config snippet for the proxy rules (apply to prod ACL after sign-off):
```json
{
  "tenant": "quantumflux",
  "region_pin": "ap-southeast-1",
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.45/32", "198.51.100.12/32"],
  "cors": ["https://app.quantumflux.ai", "https://demo.quantumflux.ai"],
  "qps_limit": 300,
  "token_scope": {"model": "v1.2", "retention": 0}
}
```
Maria (CS): Sending final confirmation email to Reva with attachments (AUP, demo token request form, quickstart). Sales flagged renewal as 'high-touch' — Sales will follow up after demo. Reva, if demo goes well we can fast-track a renewal conversation.
deploy-bot: Deployment: route-quantumflux-ap-southeast-1 created at 1781234569 by Liam (SRE) — status: queued
Liam (SRE): I'll monitor the demo window and set alerts for CPU, queue latency, and token error rate. If we see >75% CPU or p95 latency >700ms I'll manually scale to 4. Ping me in #eng-sre during the demo and I'll keep an eye.
Maria (CS): Thanks team — once Reva returns signed AUP I'll confirm prod ACL push and send the scoped token. Reva, lmk when you upload the signed doc and I'll kick the final step.
